{{Quote|Rex, have you gotten a fix on Senator Amidala's position?''"<br />"''We'll have a better lock once we get near the city, but initial scans suggest she's still alive, sir.|Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex|<ref name="CATH">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>}}
The '''capital city''' of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] was constructed on one of the planet's icy mountain peaks. The city's skyline of swooping arches and polished buildings was dominated by the massive and towering [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Additional administrative buildings surrounded the fortress-like edifice, including the chambers of the planetary government, the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]].
